steps: Sparkla, you have one, two, three, four ... fifty-eight new orders waiting for you. Please check them at your earliest convenience! W-Wait?! Why am I blocked again?!
Oh hoho! Bunny Scatter Bombs, Bunny Full-Area Suppression Rounds, and Bunny Tracking Bombs sold exactly as I expected! Even after the price hike, they still sold out without a doubt!!

There are dozens more orders specifically requesting Sparkla than before. If I can convince Sparkla to take them all...==W== I should be able to cut down the deficit from this whole incident by a lot!!
Plus the Neo Solution Leona spent an entire week refining without sleep, and… Mm-hmm, that should cover about half of it.
My precious little Dorra, hurry back to me, waaah~~
Send me the requirements for that prosthetic
Sparkla being this proactive? This has to be the first time ever she's come to me asking for a commission, right?!
Miss Willow's requirements are super simple!
First, it needs to look pretty. Second, no unnecessary bulky designs.
Function-wise, the previous one is fine.
But there is one extra request. She wants it to be waterproof. After all, the Trekker Association's work environment isn't limited to land.
In that case, as long as I maximize the waterproofing and make it a prosthetic suitable for underwater use, that should work, right? Something compatible with both freshwater and seawater.
A prosthetic you can use underwater? That's amazing! That's absolutely a selling point~
Once this order is done, if we can add waterproof specs to other models and mass-produce them, it'll definitely make a splash!
Hehe... With this, Bloc's business will be safe and sound!
Are you sure it doesn't need a function that transforms it into a bunny trumpet?
Oh, right. While you're at it, want to take the rest of my orders too~? You're already making one, what's ten more gonna hurt?
I only accepted this order because ==PLAYER_NAME== personally asked me.
Since I already promised, I'll see it through no matter how boring it is.
But aside from that, I won't accept any new orders for the next three months. I told you that already, didn't I?
Bloc, the last barrel of Neo Solution is done! That means we're finally finished, right?!
Well, isn't this rare? Sparkla actually showed up in the group chat! Oh, perfect timing! I just happen to have something important to announce!
Sparkla, Bloc! Behold my brand-new automaton! The upgraded version of Ticka-Boom!
Come on, think of those orders as a little change of pace while you're working on Tyrant Pie. A nice way to relax~
Sparkla, when your Tyrant Pie is finished, you have to tell me right away!
Ticka-Boom Ding-Dong Bang is ready to accept your challenge anytime, hahahaha!
Sparkla, are you really not going to reconsider? If ten is too many, five works too~
I specifically set up Ticka-Boom Ding-Dong Bang's test environment inside the Monolith this time.
All so it can settle things with Tyrant Pie, which is made specifically to support Monolith climbing, on the same battlefield!
If five still takes too long, then three~
Any less and my business won't be able to keep running.
Sparkla has left the group chat.
Why did Sparkla leave the group again?!
Oh no, oh no. I have a bad feeling about this...
AAAAAAAH~ I knew it!==W== She blocked me again! AAAAAAH!!
What am I supposed to do with this mountain of orders...?==B== And how am I supposed to fill the deficit now...
... Ah.==W== I just thought of a great idea~
Sigh. Leona, what do you think I should do with this huge pile of orders specifically asking for Sparkla?
Leona was the one who won first place at the last Tech Convention, but everyone still only wants Sparkla~
What do you mean, "only wants Sparkla"?! I was the champion of that convention, remember?!!
What orders do you have? Send them over and let me see!
Hmph, that's all? These are way too easy. I can make them better than Sparkla, no problem!
Exactly~ That's what I thought too! Then I'll leave these orders to you, Leona. Show everyone what you're made of~
Hmph! Just wait till you see what Leona can do!
Nice. That takes care of the order problem too.
Now I can finally open for business today~!
Welcome, welcome! Feel free to browse~
These are all treasures I personally selected while traveling all across the Nova Continent.
Take your time, have a look. There's bound to be something here just for you~
